description: Zone 30 - Tours Métropole Val de Loire is a dataset listed in opendataTMVL open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Tours Métropole Val de Loire. Les communes du territoire de Tours Métropole Val de Loire sont soucieuses de la sécurité des piétons et des cyclistes, a souhaité développer de larges zones de voiries limitées à 30km/h. Ces zones favorisent le développement des mobilités douces et contribuent à un meilleur équilibre des usages de l'espace public. Coverage: Tours Métropole Val de Loire. The portal files it under Mobilité. Its keywords are zone 30, SIG, voirie, voiture. The portal shows 98 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2023-11-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-tours-metropole-fr-portal.
